correctness.rationale: Circular factor means a substring of one conjugate with length at most 22 (no repeated winding). The 20/11 threshold is checked by integer inequality 11L>20p for a period p. The prefix property is factorial, so extending all ternary prefixes and rejecting newly introduced high-exponent suffixes exhausts every linearly admissible word. An independently written prefix search, checking every relevant period, found 3042 length-22 threshold-survivors. Independent complete doubled-word scan of every 3042 candidate with starts 0..21 and lengths 1..22 found exactly 132 circular words with CE<=20/11; canonical rotation gave precisely six classes, 22 rotations each. Computing exact least periods for these candidates confirms CE=20/11 and no smaller value; symmetry by alphabet relabeling/reversal gives one orbit. The complete finite search proves the single length 22 domain, not all word lengths. Two distinct circular critical factors have length 20 and least period 11 in the first class.
